column1: # Multivoid release ledger -- the SINGLE MINT AUTHORITY for build numbers
# (dev AND stable). Append-only; HUMAN-written; lives in the repo's own
# history because platform objects (tags, releases) are deletable and cannot
# hold an append-only invariant. Tags/releases are drift detectors only.
# kind: consume   = mint expectation (written with the tag, pushed --atomic)
#       published = human-appended closure after verifying the release page
# TERMINAL rows are PUSH-IMMEDIATE; the published row may ride the next
# leak-audited push. An empty ledger is a valid start.
